tasks.subject: Task 1: Markdown renderer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `renderMarkdown(text, resolve)` turns the spec's Markdown subset into HTML with every piece of text escaped.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/handbook/markdown.ts`
- Test: `apps/web/tests/markdown.check.ts`
- Modify: `apps/web/package.json` (add `test:markdown`, add it to `test`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Headings `#`–`###`, paragraphs, `-` and `1.` lists, `**bold**`, `` `code` ``, `[text](page-id)`, `![alt](file.png)`, pipe tables render.
- [ ] `<script>` in page text comes out as `<script>`.
- [ ] Links call `resolve('link', target)` and images `resolve('image', target)`; an unresolvable target renders as plain text, not a broken link.
- [ ] `npm run test:markdown` prints `markdown ok`.

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && npm run test:markdown` → `markdown ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/src/handbook/markdown.ts", "apps/web/tests/markdown.check.ts", "apps/web/package.json"], "verifyCommand": "`cd apps/web && npm run test:markdown` \u2192 `markdown ok`", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Catalog (pages, groups, search, panel lookup)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure `Catalog` built from `index.json` and raw page texts that answers: page by id, pages by group, the page for a panel, and search.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/handbook/catalog.ts`, `apps/web/src/handbook/index.json`
- Test: `apps/web/tests/handbook.check.ts` (first part; Task 5 extends it)
- Modify: `apps/web/package.json` (`test:handbook`, added to `test`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `makeCatalog(index, texts)` keeps `index.json` order; `forPanel('map')` returns the Map page; `search('splay')` ranks title hits before body hits and returns `[]` for an empty query.
- [ ] `npm run test:handbook` prints `handbook ok`.

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && npm run test:handbook` → `handbook ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/src/handbook/catalog.ts", "apps/web/src/handbook/index.json", "apps/web/tests/handbook.check.ts", "apps/web/package.json"], "verifyCommand": "`cd apps/web && npm run test:handbook` \u2192 `handbook ok`", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Navigation state and the panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A `Handbook` panel in the workspace that reads like a wiki: contents beside the page at 640 px or wider, one pane at a time when narrower, back/forward, breadcrumb, search, links between pages.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/handbook/bundle.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/handbook.svelte.ts`, `apps/web/src/panels/HandbookPanel.svelte`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/lib/workspace.svelte.ts` (PANELS entry)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] View tab lists **Handbook**; opening it shows the first page (`bringing-survey-data-in`).
- [ ] Clicking a link in a page goes to that page; Back and Forward walk the history.
- [ ] Panel 640 px or wider: Contents + search column on the left; narrower: a Contents button swaps the page for the list.
- [ ] Search narrows the list as you type; a result opens its page.
- [ ] `svelte-check` 0 errors.

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json` → `0 ERRORS`; dev server: open View › Handbook, click through.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/src/handbook/bundle.ts", "apps/web/src/lib/handbook.svelte.ts", "apps/web/src/panels/HandbookPanel.svelte", "apps/web/src/lib/workspace.svelte.ts"], "verifyCommand": "`cd apps/web && npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json` \u2192 `0 ERRORS`; dev server: open View \u203a Handbook, click through.", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every group header shows `?` left of Minimize; clicking it with Map in front opens the Handbook at Map. With the Handbook itself in front, `?` is hidden.
- [ ] New cave and Surface Data dialogs, and the Import menu, show "Learn more" opening `bringing-survey-data-in` (New cave, Import) or `map` (Surface Data, until its own page exists in a later slice).

**Verify:** dev server: click `?` on Map, Profile and Notebook groups → Handbook shows the matching page.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Handbook checks (coverage, links, images, sections, stale shots)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `tests/handbook.check.ts` fails the build on a panel without a page, a page for a panel that is gone, a dead link or image, a tool page missing a section, and (strict mode) a stale screenshot.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/web/tests/handbook.check.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Reads `PANELS` keys from `src/lib/workspace.svelte.ts` source text (it imports Svelte, so it cannot be imported in node), `index.json`, every `pages/*.md`.
- [ ] Fails, naming the page, when: a `PANELS` key has no `panel:` page; an `index.json` panel is not in `PANELS`; a page file has no index entry or vice versa; `[x](id)` names no page; `![x](f.png)` names no file in `shots/`; a panel page lacks any of the six headings (`When you reach for it`, `How to use it`, `What can go wrong`, `Related` as `##` headings, plus one-sentence lead paragraph and an image).
- [ ] With `HANDBOOK_STRICT=1`: fails when a `shots.json` entry's `hash` differs from the sha256 of its `source` file.

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && npm run test:handbook` → `handbook ok` once Task 7's pages exist; deleting a page's `## Related` heading → FAIL naming it.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/tests/handbook.check.ts"], "verifyCommand": "`cd apps/web && npm run test:handbook` \u2192 `handbook ok` once Task 7's pages exist; deleting a page's `## Related` heading \u2192 FAIL naming it.", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Screenshot capture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `node tools/handbook-shots.mjs <dev-url>` writes `shots/<panel>.png` for every panel page and records `shots.json` hashes.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/lib/handbook-shot.ts`, `tools/handbook-shots.mjs`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/App.svelte` (dev-only hook), `apps/web/src/components/account/AccountGate.svelte` or wherever the gate decides (skip gate in capture mode, DEV only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] In DEV only, `/?handbook-shot=map` opens the Pitfall sample, shows only the Map panel at 1100×700, no sign-in gate, no Caves window; production builds ignore the parameter (`import.meta.env.DEV` guard).
- [ ] The script writes 12 PNGs (survey only when the panel exists) and `shots.json` `{ "<panel>.png": { "source": "apps/web/src/panels/MapPanel.svelte", "hash": "<sha256>" } }`.

**Verify:** `node tools/handbook-shots.mjs http://localhost:5196` → `12 shots` (or 11 without Survey); open two PNGs to look.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/web/src/lib/handbook-shot.ts", "tools/handbook-shots.mjs", "apps/web/src/App.svelte", "apps/web/src/components/account/AccountGate.svelte"], "verifyCommand": "`node tools/handbook-shots.mjs http://localhost:5196` \u2192 `12 shots` (or 11 without Survey); open two PNGs to look.", "modelTier": "standard"}
```
